sources.enthalpy: Minus the standard enthalpy of formation of N2O(g), 82.05 kJ/mol at 298.15 K (N2 and O2 are 0): NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, table N-026, https://janaf.nist.gov/tables/N-026.html
sources.rate: Chosen for play, not fitted to measured kinetics: about 1 % a second at 1,000 K, rising steeply with temperature through an activation energy of 250 kJ/mol, the order of the energy of N2O's thermal decomposition to N2 and O. At 1,200 K k is about 1.8 per second
sources.min_temperature: Below about 850 K the rate is negligible (under 1e-4 per second), so the reaction isn't tried
